results.title: Suyodhana
results.overview: A young Foley artist has grown up hearing a mysterious voice called Suyodhana and often visualises a figure resembling Duryodhana. Raised by his mother and supported by his childhood friend and partner, his life takes a turn when he is accused of his father’s murder, leading to an investigation that uncovers deeper layers of his past.

results.title: Digérez !
results.overview: Ten-year-old Olive discovers strange marks appearing on her body on the eve of her dance performance.

results.title: The Fairfield County Four
results.overview: Four young adults disappear while investigating reports of a large, wolf-like creature. Though no trace of the four was found, their camera was eventually located. This would be the last known footage of The Fairfield County Four.

results.title: Karuppu Pulsar
results.overview: Set against the backdrop of jallikattu culture. Two men's lives intersect - one from Chennai who owns a Pulsar motorcycle and another from Madurai with a bull named Karuppu.

results.title: Riverrun
results.overview: Lucy is a musician who is slowly losing control over her body and voice. Her psychiatrist Dr. Cruz sends her to a clinic in Spain where she meets Tony. What begins as a treatment slowly becomes a journey towards an unexpected understanding of herself.

results.title: Shaka Oh Shaka
results.overview: A simple college student's life changes overnight when a chance meeting at a concert blossoms into a romance with her idol, but their deep bond is soon tested by the harsh realities and pressures of his fame.

results.title: Guria
results.overview: In Guria, western Georgia – where progress has yet to take hold following the collapse of the USSR – the locals struggle to survive day to day in the 1990s, with humor, songs, and unwavering solidarity.

results.title: NJPW Road to The New Beginning 2026 - Day 4
results.original_title: NJPW Road to The New Beginning 2026 - Day 4
results.overview: The fourth night of Road to The New Beginning 2026 was a professional wrestling event promoted by New Japan Pro-Wrestling (NJPW) that took place on January 29, 2026, at Iwate Prefectural Gymnasium in Morioka, Iwate, Japan.

results.title: ave HRUBÁ
results.overview: Poet, performer, and local legend Eva Hrubá is a woman of contradictions, sparking both devotion and public outcry. This documentary dives into her dual existence of vibrant joy and silent suffering. Moving beyond her reputation as the  "eccentric lady on a purple bike," the film explores how she transforms loneliness into art and pain into a shared celebration of life. The film explores the world of a remarkable woman, seeking the boundary between her persona as an author and her performance.

results.title: Human Hibachi 3: The Last Supper
results.overview: A man who suffers from hyper-religiosity, leads a cult of devout followers to partake in a "last supper" where sacrificed humans are the main course.

results.title: VHS Underground
results.overview: When pathologists K. Daver (Laurence R. Harvey) and Owen Graves (Jean Rises) discover a USB drive inside a corpse, curiosity leads them into horror. The files reveal disturbing recordings of murder and torture, drawing them into madness.

results.title: Saudades Eternas
results.overview: In a brick house at the heart of a Rio favela, Sueli yells, scolds, consoles. Matriarch of a noisy clan, she watches over her children and grandchildren, unfazed by the gunfire bursts that set the pace of daily life. Around her, sudden deaths multiply, the children grow up, and the house keeps changing, shaped by never-ending repairs. Still, Sueli holds her ground.

results.title: Clay Life
results.overview: A struggling actor builds a clay figurine of himself that comes to life and quickly achieves everything he has always dreamed of.

results.title: The Excrement
results.overview: This Documentary follows Detective Jessip as he hunts down Victor Valentine and his poop monster - "THE FILTH BORN"

results.title: Hungry
results.overview: A mysterious Being in a near future investigates a world devoid of human life and determines to unravel what led to the elimination of almost all lifeforms by using voice recordings they retrieved from the past – interviews made by filmmaker Susanne Brandstätter with prominent international experts and scientists before the elimination events. Each interview discloses new clues indicating what led to the deterioration of the environment, to the biosphere, to crops and finally to the extinction of humankind. Yet though Hungry’s visuals show a possible and grim future, the interviews deliver a positive argument for action: this vicious cycle can be broken before it’s too late.

results.title: Monkey Boy
results.overview: Frank is a successful comic book author who is struggling to reinvent himself. His series is no longer selling, and his publisher is pushing him to move on. But Frank lives with Monkey Boy, the main character from his series, and he doesn’t know how to let him go.

results.title: Sandy
results.overview: When an Indian teen is inadvertently outed in school, he must face school gossip, his parents' reaction, and his own self-doubt to rebuild an identity on his own terms.

results.title: The Tower
results.overview: Tereza cherishes moments of being the carefree girl she once was. She enjoys time with her boyfriend, but her thoughts drift to fears about raising Karla. She keeps her worlds apart, but one night changes everything. The Tower is a short film about losing oneself and how life's most important roles are often thrust upon us.

results.title: Paraprosdokian
results.overview: After Sara, Macie DeGraeve, gets abducted by a cult her memories begin to fracture as the truth is revealed.
